subject: linguistic_audit output contract
finding: The provider registry assigns linguistic_audit, but the package has no role-specific prompt and closed response schema.
required_action: Approve the exact prompt and wire contract before that role is implemented.
runtime_rule: Block this role. Do not repurpose a schema that allows invented human evidence.

subject: Gold coverage counting
finding: The six-per-leaf policy includes permitted-variant leaves. A true-error counterpart cannot itself be a permitted-variant error.
required_action: Approve the exact pairing and counting rule for negative-control leaves and multi-target audio assets.
runtime_rule: Retain the planned numbers. Do not claim complete coverage until the counting rule is approved.

subject: Category alias map
finding: The scoring procedure requires a frozen alias map. No approved bilingual alias artifact exists.
required_action: Approve the exact alias entries and their version before synonym-dependent category credit.
runtime_rule: Do not invent aliases. Correct detection can remain separate from unresolved category credit.

subject: Hard render constraints
finding: The blueprint stores hard_render_constraints as unrestricted strings. It has no closed capability vocabulary for those strings.
required_action: Approve a typed capability catalog and conflict rules for each added constraint.
runtime_rule: Reject an unregistered hard constraint. Do not guess its meaning or weaken its target.

subject: Speech tokenization and pause measurement
finding: Auxiliary formulas name spoken tokens and pauses. The package does not fully specify contraction tokenization or a versioned speech-interval method.
required_action: Approve the exact tokenizer and interval method before cross-case acoustic comparisons.
runtime_rule: Do not claim comparable rate or density values without the method version.

subject: Prosody feature methods and units
finding: The schema permits several feature and unit combinations. The package does not provide all valid pairs or extraction methods.
required_action: Approve the exact per-feature method, unit, and measurement boundary.
runtime_rule: Require observed human evidence for unsupported targets. Do not invent automatic numeric measurements.

subject: Requested accent and full acoustic generation
finding: The named TTS profiles do not prove that every requested learner accent or prosodic target can be produced.
required_action: Obtain real capability evidence for each required case. A new provider or substitute needs its own owner decision.
runtime_rule: Fail an unrealized target. Preserve the full domain instead of silently removing the category.

subject: Existing numerical acceptance policy
finding: The package retains engineering weights and thresholds. No empirical validation or separate owner approval record accompanies those numbers.
required_action: Approve each changed numerical property explicitly. Measure the fixed policy on real held-out data before release.
runtime_rule: Describe these values as inherited policy candidates, not validated teaching norms.
